h1: Drinkware Testing: Define the Product & Acceptance Criteria
lead: State the product, destination and intended use, then agree the relevant test method and acceptance criteria. A method described on a factory page is not proof that every model has passed every test.
html:
Give Your Next Sourcing Decision a Clearer Direction

Bring these decisions back to your actual product, drink or brand project. Clear specifications, samples and approval targets help your team work from the same brief.

Does listing a test method prove that every model has passed it?

State the product, destination and intended use, then agree the relevant test method and acceptance criteria. A method described on a factory page is not proof that every model has passed every test.

What should the quotation and sample review include?

For drinkware testing: define the product & acceptance criteria, provide the use, model or reference, intended quantity and the information needed to review model, test conditions and acceptance requirements. Identify essential requirements and undecided items so the quote and sample review address the same brief.

How should a fixed project date be handled?

State the required arrival date and destination at the start. We will assist you with artwork or design, sample approval, production and transit milestones separately. We will help you review the timing impact of any change to an approved specification; service scope and timing need project confirmation.
